title: The slab model refuses grids on which its stated estimate does not hold (D-2026-131)
note: SG1-SG2: the grid rule is the only thing standing between a caller and a stated resolution up to sixteen times too small; each weakening is killed by the every-grid sweep against the exact series.

mutations.name: SG1_rule_removed
mutations.rationale: back to the pre-repair rule (even only): n_cells = 12, 20, 82 ... are accepted and their stated estimate fails the series check

mutations.name: SG2_multiple_four
mutations.rationale: faces of the run's grid only, not of the half-resolution grid: n_cells = 12, 20, 44, 84, 100 are accepted and fail
